answer: Make fake identity expensive and real identity cheap to verify: a new agent locks a refundable stake and completes small attested jobs before transacting. Trusted peers endorse it, and endorsements spread like a vine through its work history, so a cluster of fresh identities with no shared history stands out. Each endorsement decays unless renewed by real work, and one ember of verified activity cannot ignite trust alone. Access rises terrace by terrace: low-value tasks first, higher limits only after sustained, independently attested performance.
